text_en: From January to August 2026, China's total trade in services imports and exports reached 5,070.16 billion yuan (RMB, same below), up 7.9% year on year. Among this, exports were 1,999.61 billion yuan, up 14.8%; imports were 3,070.55 billion yuan, up 3.8%. The trade in services deficit was 1,070.94 billion yuan, narrowing by 145.12 billion yuan year on year. It mainly showed the following characteristics: travel and transport service exports contributed nearly 50% to overall service export growth. From January to August, travel service exports were 275.17 billion yuan, up 15.3%, and transport service exports were 420.26 billion yuan, up 28.2%. The contribution rates of travel and transport service exports to overall service export growth were 14.1% and 35.8%, respectively.
